issue.title: Theme rename rewrites untouched CRLF note line endings
issue.description: Discovered by bob-cli-db.land while auditing bob-cli-db.1. src/native/pomodoro_themes/rename.rs::rewrite_file_contents (introduced by 4a6f4494, bob-cli-bc.6) uses contents.lines() and join("\n"), stripping CR from every CRLF line. verify_rename also compares lines() so accepts the unwanted changes. Reproduced in a clean isolated Git fixture with core.autocrlf=false and a CRLF daily note containing ## Pomodoros, one JOB placeholder, and an untouched indented child: bob themes rename JOB WRITE -o -f json exits 0/ok=true but all three terminators become LF. Fix global rename with byte-preserving tail splicing and raw-byte verification; cover CRLF, mixed endings, trailing spaces, and no final newline while retaining transaction rollback and journal behavior. Do not redo the live JOB migration. Same-type/all-type searches and last-week task sweeps found no duplicate; all active epics reviewed, with bc already closed and db adding only split. Focused small scope with known root cause.

task_type_fields.impact: Global theme rename changes unrelated bytes and its verification incorrectly accepts the collateral rewrite.
task_type_fields.repro: In a clean Git test vault with core.autocrlf=false, write a CRLF daily note with one JOB Pomodoro and an untouched child. Run bob themes rename JOB WRITE -o -f json. It returns ok=true but converts every CRLF to LF, including the heading and child.

issue.creation_reason: Found while landing bob-cli-db: the older global rename path independently violates its tail-only byte-preservation contract. Its originating epic bob-cli-bc is closed, and this is separate from the new split repair.
